description: Figure 3 is a donut chart that illustrates the relationship between inter-annotator agreement and two measures of ambiguity: sample-level ambiguity standard deviation and sample-level maximum ambiguity. The chart is divided into two concentric rings. The outer ring, labeled "Ambiguity Std (Outer)," represents the standard deviation of ambiguity, with segments corresponding to different standard deviation values: Std: 0.0 (7.0%), Std: 0.47 (47.7%), Std: 0.82 (19.0%), and Std: 0.94 (5.0%). The inner ring, labeled "Max Ambiguity (Inner)," represents the maximum ambiguity, with segments for Max: 1 (14.2%), Max: 2 (39.0%), and Max: 3 (38.0%). The chart visually compares the distribution of samples across these ambiguity levels, with the outer ring showing a higher concentration of samples with a standard deviation of 0.47, and the inner ring showing a relatively even distribution across the maximum ambiguity levels.
